name: Death Hunter's Requiem
source:
Jounoichi "Joey" Nakahara only lived for the act of 'normalcy' for most of his life, the only thing preventing that being the mysterious medical condition he developed after a traumatizing attack at a young age and escaping home with his older brother. However, when he suddenly gains the ability to hear other people's thoughts and is attacked by a vicious monster known as a Tergiversator, his life changes forever.  Stuck with this power and the encounter of the illusive Ashino Aurion, he must unravel these secrets of their past and become a Death Hunter. 

But the question is, "What IS a Death Hunter?"

A Death Hunter is.....

[From [url=https://deathhunterashi.itch.io/deathhuntersrequiemepisode1]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
乔伊·中原城一 (Jounoichi “Joey” Nakahara) 一生中的大部分时间都只为“正常”而生活，唯一阻止这种情况发生的是他在年轻时遭受创伤性袭击并与哥哥一起逃亡后患上的神秘疾病。然而，当他突然获得了倾听他人想法的能力并遭到名为“Tergiversator”的邪恶怪物的攻击时，他的生活永远改变了。被这种力量所困，并遇到了虚幻的芦野奥里安，他必须解开他们过去的这些秘密，并成为一名死亡猎人。

但问题是，“什么是死亡猎人？”

死亡猎人是……

[来自[url=https://deathhunterashi.itch.io/deathhuntersrequiemepisode1]Itch.io[/url]]
